definitions.gloss: water temperature (of a body of water, an aquarium, a hot bath, an engine cooling system, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The temperature of water in any context — the sea, rivers, swimming pools, fish tanks, hot baths, kettles, or the cooling systems of cars and machinery. {水温|すいおん} is a neutral, technical-flavored term used wherever water temperature needs to be specified.

examples.japanese: {水温|すいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。

examples.english: The sea temperature is low today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}→熱帯魚：19146_nettaigyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水温|すいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二十六|にじゅうろく}⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When keeping tropical fish, you need to maintain the water temperature at around 26 degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧{水温|すいおん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{気候変動|きこうへんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{指標|しひょう}→指標：12816_shihyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The recent rise in sea-surface water temperatures is regarded as an important indicator of the effects of climate change.

notes:
{水温|すいおん} simply means "water temperature" — the temperature of water in any context.

FORMS:
- {水|すい} ("water") + {温|おん} (from ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧ "temperature") → {水温|すいおん}

TYPICAL DOMAINS:
- Marine and freshwater science (⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水温|すいおん}, ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水温|すいおん})
- Aquarium hobby and fish farming
- Swimming and diving (pool and ocean temperatures)
- Hot baths and onsen (spring water temperatures)
- Automotive ({水温|すいおん}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧: engine coolant-temperature gauge)
- Industrial and chemical processes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水温|すいおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ / ⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: water temperature rises / falls
- {水温|すいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure water temperature
- {水温|すいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain a water temperature
- {水温|すいおん}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧: water-temperature gauge / thermometer
- ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧{水温|すいおん}: sea-surface temperature (a key meteorological / climate term)
- ⟦{適正|てきせい}→適正：09686_tekisei⟧{水温|すいおん}: optimal water temperature

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧: air temperature — the parallel word for ambient air
- ⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧: body temperature
- ⟦{室温|しつおん}→室温：25310_shitsuon⟧: room temperature
- ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧: temperature (general) — the umbrella term; {水温|すいおん} = ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧
- {湯温|ゆおん}: hot-water temperature — a closely related word focused on heated water (baths, kettles, hot springs); often more natural than {水温|すいおん} when the water is intentionally hot
- {海水温|かいすいおん}: sea-water temperature — a more specific compound, common in marine science and weather news

USAGE:
- For an extremely hot bath or kettle, {湯温|ゆおん} is more idiomatic than {水温|すいおん}: ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湯温|ゆおん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四十二|よんじゅうに}⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧です ("the bath temperature is 42 degrees").
- {水温|すいおん} is preferred when the water in question is naturally cool, when the temperature could be high or low, or when it is being measured/controlled in a technical setting.
